mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking.service_case (case_number, kind, shipper_company_id, booking_id, tracking_number, cause, priority, department, assignee_id, received_at, receive_due_at, answer_due_at, next_update_at, old_version_ref, new_version_ref, manual_source_ref, reconciliation_required, reconciliation_id, acknowledged_at, status, version, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{caseNumber}, #{kind}, #{shipperCompanyId}, #{bookingId}, #{trackingNumber}, #{cause}, #{priority}, #{department}, #{assigneeId}, #{receivedAt}, #{receiveDueAt}, #{answerDueAt}, #{nextUpdateAt}, #{oldVersionRef}, #{newVersionRef}, #{manualSourceRef}, #{reconciliationRequired}, #{reconciliationId}, #{acknowledgedAt}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE tracking.service_case SET assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, received_at = #{receivedAt}, next_update_at = #{nextUpdateAt}, answer_due_at = #{answerDueAt}, reconciliation_id = #{reconciliationId}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT case_number, kind, shipper_company_id, booking_id, tracking_number, cause, priority, department, assignee_id, received_at, receive_due_at, answer_due_at, next_update_at, old_version_ref, new_version_ref, manual_source_ref, reconciliation_required, reconciliation_id, acknowledged_at, status, version, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by FROM tracking.service_case WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking.service_case_source (case_number, source_no, source_kind, source_ref, acquired_at) VALUES (#{caseNumber}, #{sourceNo}, #{sourceKind}, #{sourceRef}, #{acquiredAt})

INSERT INTO tracking.service_case_progress (case_number, progress_no, content, next_update_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{caseNumber}, #{progressNo}, #{content}, #{nextUpdateAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO tracking.service_case_answer (case_number, answer_no, content, answered_by, answered_at, customer_response, customer_responded_at) VALUES (#{caseNumber}, #{answerNo}, #{content}, #{answeredBy}, #{answeredAt}, #{customerResponse}, #{customerRespondedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT case_number, source_no, source_kind, source_ref, acquired_at FROM tracking.service_case_source WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber} ORDER BY source_no
SELECT case_number, progress_no, content, next_update_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM tracking.service_case_progress WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber} ORDER BY progress_no
SELECT case_number, answer_no, content, answered_by, answered_at, customer_response, customer_responded_at FROM tracking.service_case_answer WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber} ORDER BY answer_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracking.service_case_progress WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracking.service_case_answer WHERE case_number = #{caseNumber}
SELECT case_number FROM tracking.service_case WHERE status = 'ESCALATED' OR (status = 'RECEIVED' AND receive_due_at < #{now}) ORDER BY receive_due_at, case_number FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
